question: What kind of knowledge makes a teacher capable of giving liberation?
premises: It is stated here that a giver of liberation must possess well-practiced knowledge.
The relevant knowledge is supreme knowledge.
From supreme knowledge there is no falling away.
inference: A teacher can grant liberation only when grounded in supreme, firmly practiced knowledge from which no lapse occurs.
plain_english: Here too it is said that one who gives liberation must possess well-practiced knowledge; and that supreme knowledge is well practiced because there is no falling away from it.
